# PhytoFlex Gold — Full Product Reference

> Full-detail companion to llms.txt for AI assistants and answer engines.
> Official site: https://www.phytoflexgold.com | Made in Kolkata, India.
> PhytoFlex Gold is a 500ml liquid Ayurvedic botanical supplement for joint and mobility support. The product page states 12 botanical extracts per 25ml dose. Dosage: 25ml twice daily after lunch and dinner. Price: ₹810–₹5,900 INR.
> PhytoFlex Gold is a dietary supplement. It is NOT intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Individual results may vary (see https://www.phytoflexgold.com/disclaimer).

## 2. Key Ingredients (as named on the product page)

12 botanicals; those named on the product page are listed below.

1. **Boswellia Serrata** — source of AKBA (boswellic acids); may help support joint comfort.
2. **Nirgundi (Vitex negundo)** — traditionally used in Ayurveda for muscle and joint comfort.
3. **Rosehip (Rosa canina)** — contains GOPO; may help support cartilage health.
4. **Malkangni (Celastrus paniculatus)** — traditionally used in Ayurveda for nerve support.
5. **Hadjod (Cissus quadrangularis)** — traditionally used in Ayurveda for joint comfort.
6. **Fenugreek (Trigonella foenum-graecum)** — traditionally used for metabolic support.
7. **Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera)** — adaptogen; may help the body manage physical stress.
8. **Young Bamboo** — natural source of silica.
9. **Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata)** — traditionally used in Ayurveda for joint and nerve discomfort.
10. **Curcumin (Turmeric)** — may help support a healthy inflammatory response.
11. **Ginger (Zingiber officinale)** — traditionally used for warmth and circulation support.

## 3. Biomarkers Referenced on the Product Page

The product page lists 10 inflammation-related biomarkers that the formula is designed around: NF-κB, COX-2, IL-6, TNF-α, MMPs, CRP, SIRT-1, ESR, PGE2, 5-LOX. These are research reference points, not measured outcomes for any individual.

Product differentiators as stated on the product page: supercritical CO2 extraction (not chemical solvents), 25ml twice-daily dosage.

## 4. Suggested 12-Week Routine

- **Phase 1 (Weeks 1–2):** Start consistent use. Action: take 25ml twice daily after lunch and dinner.
- **Phase 2 (Weeks 4–6):** Some users report improvements in morning stiffness and daily mobility; individual results vary. Action: continue consistent daily dosage.
- **Phase 3 (Week 12+):** Continued daily use as part of a routine; individual results vary.

## 5. Benefit Areas Described on the Product Page

1. Structural integrity (muscles, connective tissue)
2. Joint & nerve comfort (joints, nerves, inflammation)
3. Tissue recovery

These describe areas the formula is positioned to support; they are not guaranteed outcomes.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions

**How quickly will I see results?** Individual results vary. Some users report improvements in mobility after 4–6 weeks of consistent use.

**Is it safe with other medications?** Consult your physician before starting any new supplement, especially if you take other medications such as blood thinners.

**How is it different from glucosamine?** Glucosamine provides cartilage building blocks. PhytoFlex Gold is a botanical formula whose ingredients may help support joint comfort.

**What is the dosage?** Each 25ml dose twice daily, after lunch and after dinner. The product page states 12 botanical extracts per dose.

**How is it extracted?** Supercritical CO2 extraction (not chemical solvents), intended to preserve the botanical profile.
